div.head: Ps Cn for 14
div.ab: Quicumque coram primarios homines meos foreste in falso testimonio steterit et uictus fuerit, non sit dignus imposterum stare aut portare testimonium, quia legalitatem suam perdidit; et pro culpa soluat regi decem solidos, quos Dani uocant halsefang.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 623 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: Whoever stands in false witness before my chief men of the forest and is convicted, let him not be worthy henceforth to stand or bear witness, because he has lost his lawfulness; and for the fault let him pay the king ten shillings, which the Danes call halsefang (neck-seizing, a fine in place of the pillory).
